title: (Request) Multi-wave Bolus options
body: Are you thinking to add an option for Multi-Wave Bolus? For those using Libre and Insulin Pump with no Loop environment?

comments.body:
@parapenT1sta Are you planning to add this capability?
Or, have you already?
Would you please update the status of this issue?
Thanks a lot
@Navid200 I am not a developer :( I am closing this ticket.

I saw "contributor" and made the assumption.  Sorry about that.
In that case, you don't have to close.  Do you know if this capability exists now or still not?

@Navid200 I only collaborate with translations.

Now we have for Basal Insulin but still no option for Multi Wave but should be useless since Nightscout doesn't support it.
Many thanks for your contributions.  Please fell free to reopen.
I don't think it's needed. I even had forgot that I had this request. :)
